meta.title: Testimonial Card Block demo
meta.description: A static Gutenberg block: testimonial card with avatar, byline, star rating, two block styles and core block supports.
meta.author: jdyach

steps.code:
<?php
/**
 * Demo content for the WordPress Playground "Try it live" link.
 *
 * Runs once inside Playground (blueprint.json embeds this file). Uploads the
 * demo avatars, builds a page of testimonial cards from demo-content.html and
 * opens that page in the block editor.
 *
 * demo-content.html was generated by the block editor itself
 * (wp.blocks.serialize), so it always matches what save() outputs and never
 * shows "This block contains unexpected content".
 *
 * Not loaded by the plugin.
 *
 * @package TestimonialCardBlock
 */

// phpcs:disable WordPress.WP.GlobalVariablesOverride -- Standalone demo script that Playground runs once in global scope.

require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

wp_set_current_user( 1 );

// Find this plugin's folder, whatever Playground named it.
$plugin_dir = dirname( (string) current( glob( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/*/testimonial-card-block.php' ) ) );

foreach ( get_posts(
	array(
		'post_type'   => array( 'post', 'page' ),
		'numberposts' => -1,
		'post_status' => 'any',
	)
) as $old ) {
	wp_delete_post( $old->ID, true );
}

$content = file_get_contents( $plugin_dir . '/_playground/demo-content.html' ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_get_contents_file_get_contents

// Upload each avatar and swap its placeholder URL and ID into the markup.
$avatars = array(
	'dana'   => 9001,
	'marcus' => 9002,
	'priya'  => 9003,
	'owen'   => 9004,
);
foreach ( $avatars as $name => $placeholder_id ) {
	$upload = wp_upload_bits( "avatar-$name.webp", null, file_get_contents( "$plugin_dir/_playground/avatars/$name.webp" ) ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_get_contents_file_get_contents
	if ( ! empty( $upload['error'] ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$id = wp_insert_attachment(
		array(
			'post_mime_type' => 'image/webp',
			'post_title'     => ucfirst( $name ),
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
		),
		$upload['file']
	);
	wp_update_attachment_metadata( $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $id, $upload['file'] ) );

	$content = str_replace(
		array( '__AVATAR_' . strtoupper( $name ) . '__', '"avatarId":' . $placeholder_id ),
		array( esc_url_raw( $upload['url'] ), '"avatarId":' . $id ),
		$content
	);
}

wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'import_id'    => 100, // Fixed ID so the blueprint can open this page in the editor.
		'post_title'   => 'Testimonials',
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_content' => $content,
	)
);

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', 100 );
update_option( 'blogname', 'Testimonial Card Block' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'Live demo' );

// Skip the editor's welcome guide so visitors land straight on the blocks.
update_user_meta(
	1,
	$GLOBALS['wpdb']->get_blog_prefix() . 'persisted_preferences',
	array(
		'core/edit-post' => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false ),
		'core'           => array( 'welcomeGuide' => false ),
		'_modified'      => gmdate( 'c' ),
	)
);
